Visit resource ↗ Repository Workflow A formal, auditable and librarian-controlled pathway protects metadata quality, copyright compliance and institutional reputation. 1 Submit Staff or authorised officers submit metadata, identifiers, files and institutional context. 2 Validate The system checks required fields, duplicates, formats and faculty/department relationships. 3 Review Librarians assess metadata, copyright, licence, URLs and uploaded evidence. 4 Approve Authorised officers approve the record and determine access or embargo conditions. 5 Publish The platform creates a persistent repository record and exposes approved metadata. 6 Measure Views, downloads, turnaround and open-access indicators feed management analytics.
